node: Transmission-line hardware, fittings, conductor accessories, and installation-enabling components
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the transmission-line hardware and installation-enabling node. The cleanest underfollowed candidate is Preformed Line Products, which appears unusually close to formed-wire, conductor, OPGW, telecom-line, and utility hardware demand. Hubbell is the obvious diversified reference supplier, while MYR Group is an installation/labor-productivity context name rather than a hardware manufacturer. Valmont is a plausible second-order structural-pole and utility-infrastructure supplier, but its fit is broader and needs verification at the product/customer level. No buy/sell view is implied.
